title: Left 4 Dead 2
provenance: Reported by greph123 (highball-db#78, 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-18): Apple M2 MacBook Air with 8 GB, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, Highball 0.9.19. First rated 2, laggy on Wine's Direct3D and frozen at campaign load on DXVK; the cause was the many workshop add-ons loading, and with those off the game ran flawlessly at maximum settings at 1280x820. Mode of the clean run not stated. Not run here.
notes: Runs well on an M2 Air once workshop add-ons are not loaded automatically; with them the campaign froze at load on DXVK and crawled on Wine's Direct3D. The mode of the clean run is not recorded yet. A Source game, so DXVK is the expected mode.

knownIssues.symptom: Campaign freezes as it loads on DXVK, or runs at very low fps on Wine's Direct3D
knownIssues.cause: reported: many workshop add-ons loading at start (M2 Air, 8 GB)
knownIssues.fix: Disable the add-ons from loading automatically, then play

knownIssues.symptom: Freezes during a match, the log shows 'out of realized font handles' (M5, default engine r28, highball#525)
knownIssues.cause: the default Wine 10 engine allows 256 realized fonts and the game runs past that, as Portal 2 and Counter-Strike Source do. Started from the Steam window it also inherits sync off
knownIssues.fix: start it with Play in Highball, and if it still freezes move the environment to a Wine 11 engine (limit 5000)
